1.description: [Elune] [Dragon Roar] - Doubled the base damage of Dragon Roar.
[Elune] [Mutilate] - Mutilate now deals 10% more damage for each of your Poisons on the target.
[Elune] [System Shock] - Increased the base damage and scaling of System Shock by 50%.
[Elune] [Poison Nova] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Poison Nova by 30%.
[Elune] [Goremaw's Bite] - Fixed an issue where the trigger chance was rolled individually on each target hit, instead of on cast. The damage of Goremaw's Bite has been increased by 20%.
[Elune] [Talonshrike] - Raptor Strike now also reduces the cooldown of Fury of the Eagle by 2 seconds.
[Elune] [Blade of the Magisters] - Blade of the Magisters now increases the damage done by Arcane Mage spells by 15% per stack, up from 12%.
[Elune] [Etheric Vengeance] - Now triggers Righteous Vengeance at 20% of the damage done, up from 15%.
[Elune] [Divine Reset] - Now reduces the cooldown of Guardian of Ancient Kings by 10 seconds, up from 6 seconds.
[Elune] [Harnessed Energy] - Fixed a bug causing Arcane Shot and Arcane Bullet to not consume stacks of Harnessed Energy.
[Elune] [Arcane Shelling] - Now increases the damage of Arcane Barrage by 30%, up from 20%. Arcane Shot and Aimed Shots modifiers remain at 20%.
[Elune] [Arcane Reloading] - Dealing Arcane spell damage to a target affected by your Black Arrow has a 20% chance to extend its duration by 2 seconds. This effect has a 1 second cooldown.
[Elune] [Arcane Aiming] - Increased the base damage and scaling of Arcane Aiming by 30%.
[Elune] [Arcane Gunslinger] - Now increases the damage of your next Arcane Barrage by 50% against monsters per stack, up from 20%.
[Elune] [Rune-etched Bullets] - Fixed a bug causing Rune-etched Bullets to not grant additional charges of Harnessed Energy.
[Elune] [Rune-etched Bullets] - Now grants 4 stacks of Arcane Blast or Harnessed Energy.
[Elune] [Rune-etched Bullets] - Now has a 33% chance to trigger, up from 25%.
[Elune] [Rune-etched Bullets] - Now increases the damage of your next Arcane Blast by 200% against monsters, up from 100%. It now also sets the Arcane Blast global cooldown to 1 second.
[Elune] [Shot Weaving] - Gunslingers Barrage can now trigger Piercing Shots.
[Elune] [Ready to Demolish!] - Fixed a bug causing Ready to Demolish! to not increase the damage of Mongoose Bite.
[Elune] [Twin Fangs] - The proc chance of Twin Fangs has been increased to 33%, up from 25%.
[Elune] [Twin Fangs] - Triggering Twin Fangs now also reduces the cooldown of Raptor Strike and Mongoose Bite by 1 second, and Glaive Toss by 3 seconds.
[Elune] [Twin Fangs] - Now deals 125% of the damage done by the triggering Mongoose Bite or Counterattack against monsters, up from 50%. It remains at 50% against players.
[Elune] [Deadly Instinct] - Now increases the damage of Mongoose Bite by 60% against monsters, up from 40%.

[Elune] [Locust Cascade] This talent has a new mechanic: Hitting a target affected by Insect Swarm with Toxic Surge is guaranteed to, and Hunter shots have a chance 20% chance to increase the damage taken from your Wrath and Serpent Sting by 12% against monsters, and 4% against players. Stacking 6 times. The duration of this aura cannot be refreshed.
[Elune] [Coldshot] - Is now a buff on the caster instead of a debuff on the struck targets. This is meant to make the benefit easier to utilize in quick paced encounters, and on target swaps.

[Elune] [Rising Chaos] - Fixed a bug causing Chaos Burns damage-over-time portion to benefit from the damage increase of Rising Chaos. These type of effects should only benefit things that also consume them.
[Elune] [Frozen Munitions] - Fixed a bug causing the Cone of Cold empowerment to also increase damage-over-time effects classed as Cone of Cold without consuming the effect.
[Pending Restart] The heal from Halo is now able to trigger procs.
